facts.audience: busy parents who book check-ups for their kids
facts.problem: appointments get missed and the chair sits empty
facts.cause: the only reminder is an email sent the evening before, which many parents don't see until it is too late to rearrange (from the practice's front-desk notes)
facts.solution: a text reminder two days ahead that patients can reply to, to confirm or reschedule
facts.outcome: when someone can't make it, they can tell the practice early, so the slot can be offered to another patient

headline: One email,

chapters.narration: Our only reminder: an email the evening before, seen too late.

chapters.narration: Now a text comes two days ahead. Reply early, and the slot goes to another patient.
